about_the_game:
The Astral Dusk Demo is a limited version of Astral Dusk. Get a snapshot of the core elements of the horror that you will experience.

Astral Dusk is a first-person, crafting horror survival game following a lone astronaut marooned on the edge of a deep, dark moon crater. Scavenge various resources, debris, and alien plant life to craft tools to venture further into the void, ultimately to fix your damaged rocket and blast off into space. But beware, spacer, you aren't the only thing down there.

Key Features:

Crafting: Use the various resources you scavenge in the crater to craft tools, equipment, and upgrades to expand your reach further. Be mindful of what resources you choose to bring back.

Exploration: Stare into the abyss as you descend into the unknown. Scavenge destroyed spaceship debris, adventure into otherworldly alien plantlife, and collect raw resources.

Survival: Face the harsh reality of the crater, where your only light source is the flashlight you bring. Manage your equipment carefully while avoiding the creatures that lurk in the dark.

Oxygen Management: Your oxygen is your lifeline. Plan your descent carefully, watch your oxygen levels, and return to the elevator before supplies run out. Be careful not to venture too far or risk suffocating in the abyss.

As we progress through development please check back for updates on the demo so you can try new features as they are added.
